# Quiet Hours: pause in-app alerts

Members can now pause their own Pulseboard in-app alerts for **1 hour** or **Until tomorrow** from notification settings. Email alerts and other members' settings are unchanged. <!-- evidence: C02, C03 -->

- The screen shows the selected end time and a **Resume now** action. <!-- evidence: C04 -->
- In-app alerts resume when the period ends or when the member selects **Resume now**. <!-- evidence: C05 -->
- Pausing requires an online connection. <!-- evidence: C06 -->
